title: Brain — local truthful knowledge engine
description: One portable knowledge.sqlite + Obsidian vault over a mixed corpus (docs + spreadsheets). Meaning is agentic (RAG/graph), numbers are computed (deterministic SQL). No server. Installs the full build+answer toolchain as one curated set.

deps.venv: isolated, owned by the skills (not the project); default <project>/.claude/venv, or --user for a shared ~/.claude/venv
deps.notes: sqlite3 is stdlib; fastembed/pypdf/openpyxl need no torch, but docling (PPTX/DOCX) pulls torch/transformers (~1.3 GB installed). Install via `install.sh --deps` (uv) or run with `uv run --with-requirements`.
